description: This file defines the implementation for discovering Tailscale gateways on macOS. It includes data structures representing discovered gateways, functions to run Tailscale status commands, network probing, and WebSocket interactions to identify available gateways within a given timeout period.

classes.name: TailscaleServeGatewayBeacon
classes.description: Represents a discovered Tailscale gateway with display name, DNS, host, and port.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Performs asynchronous discovery of Tailscale gateways within a specified timeout, returning an array of beacons.

methods.name: collectCandidates
methods.description: Collects potential gateway candidates from Tailscale status data.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the current Tailscale status in JSON format by executing the 'tailscale' CLI.
